context: Expert witness Professor Dr. Baar explains that motor protection is a matter of design choice, redefining necessity as subjective rather than objective.

category: Redefinition of acceptable risk and standards
label: Motor protection invoked by poor engineering as justification
original_label: Motor protection invoked by poor engineering as justification
quote: Ich muss nur schlecht genug konstruieren, dann kann ich den Motorschutz in Anspruch nehmen.
english_gloss: I only have to construct poorly enough, then I can invoke motor protection.
context: Witness Professor Dr. Wachtmeister identifies a perverse incentive: poor motor design can be justified by invoking motor protection.

label: Cycle beating as technical necessity, not manipulation
original_label: Cycle beating as technical necessity, not manipulation
quote: The reine Zykluserkennung ist legal und liefert keine Anhaltspunkte für ein unzulässiges Verhalten... es ist aus technischen Gründen sogar zwingend, dass Fahrzeuge mit einer Software ausgestattet sind, die den Rollenprüfstand und damit auch eine Emissionsmessung erkennt.
english_gloss: Mere cycle recognition is legal and provides no indication of impermissible conduct... it is even technically imperative that vehicles be equipped with software that recognizes the test bench and thus also emission measurement.
context: Federal expert characterizes test cycle recognition as technically necessary and legal, normalizing what could be viewed as manipulation as routine engineering.

label: NEFZ weaknesses as universal justification for gaps
original_label: NEFZ weaknesses as universal justification for gaps
quote: Die Diskrepanz zwischen den bei der Typgenehmigung ermittelten Messwerten und den realen Abgasemissionen und Kraftstoffverbräuchen war dem Kraftfahrt-Bundesamt wie auch allen anderen Experten bereits seit langem bekannt. Selbst auffällig hohe Messwertabweichungen um das siebenfache ließen jedoch keinen Rückschluss auf eine Manipulation der Abgasregulierung zur Einhaltung der Grenzwerte im Rahmen der Emissionsprüfung zu.
english_gloss: The discrepancy between measured values in type approval and real exhaust emissions and fuel consumption was known to the KBA and all other experts for a long time. However, even conspicuously high measurement value deviations of sevenfold permitted no conclusion of a manipulation of exhaust regulation to comply with limit values in the context of emission testing.
context: The Bundestag committee explains that seven-fold emission deviations were attributed to NEFZ weaknesses rather than manipulation, normalizing large discrepancies.

label: Source code withheld under business secrecy
original_label: Source code withheld under business secrecy
quote: Der Quellcode der Motorsteuerungssoftware sowie die Emissionsminderungsstrategie war mit Blick auf den erforderlichen Schutz von Betriebs- und Geschäftsgeheimnissen in der als Anlage der Richtlinie 2007/46/EG inhaltlich standardisierten Beschreibungsmappe jedoch zu keinem Zeitpunkt genannt und damit vom Hersteller nicht offen zu legen.
english_gloss: The source code of the engine control software and the emission reduction strategy were not mentioned at any time in the content standardized description folder pursuant to the Directive 2007/46/EG with regard to the required protection of operating and trade secrets, and thus did not have to be disclosed by the manufacturer.
context: The committee notes that manufacturers were not required to disclose source code or emission strategy due to business secrecy protections, preventing regulators from detecting manipulation.

label: Fragmented roles prevent holistic oversight
original_label: Fragmented roles prevent holistic oversight
quote: Nach den Vorgaben der Richtlinie 2007/46/EG verteilen sich die Kernaufgaben und Rollen im Prozess einer EG-Fahrzeugtypgenehmigung also wie folgt: Der Hersteller stellt die Antragsunterlagen zusammen... prüft der Technische Dienst... erteilt das Kraftfahrt-Bundesamt abschließend die EG-Fahrzeugtypgenehmigung.
english_gloss: According to the provisions of Directive 2007/46/EG, the core tasks and roles in the process of an EC vehicle type approval are distributed as follows: the manufacturer compiles the application documents... the Technical Service tests... the KBA finally issues the EC vehicle type approval.
context: The committee describes how the type approval process fragmented oversight across manufacturers, technical services and the KBA, each with specialized roles.

label: VW gradually reduced scope of CO2 manipulation claims
original_label: VW gradually reduced scope of CO2 manipulation claims
quote: Nach Information von Volkswagen vom 3. November 2015 sollen nach internen Untersuchungen rund 800.000 Dieselfahrzeuge des Volkswagen-Konzerns von Unregelmäßigkeiten bei den CO2-Werten und damit dem Kraftstoffverbrauch betroffen gewesen sein. Nur einen Monat später habe VW der Untersuchungskommission am 3. Dezember 2015 dann jedoch mitgeteilt, dass statt der zunächst befürchteten etwa 130 Modelltypen aus dem Modelljahr 2016 tatsächlich nur neun Modellvarianten betroffen seien.
english_gloss: According to information from Volkswagen dated November 3, 2015, approximately 800,000 diesel vehicles in the Volkswagen Group were allegedly affected by irregularities in CO2 values and thus fuel consumption. However, only one month later, on December 3, 2015, VW informed the investigation commission that instead of the initially feared approximately 130 model types from model year 2016, only nine model variants were actually affected.
context: VW initially claimed 800,000 vehicles with CO2 irregularities, then within one month reduced this to only nine variants, demonstrating escalating misrepresentation to regulators.

label: KBA leadership unfamiliar with prohibition on defeat devices
original_label: KBA leadership unfamiliar with prohibition on defeat devices
quote: Dass allerdings dem Leiter des Kraftfahrt-Bundesamtes die Begrifflichkeit bis September 2015 völlig unbekannt gewesen sei, ist schwer nachvollziehbar. Das Verbot zum Einsatz von Abschalteinrichtungen existierte bereits in der Vorgängervorschrift und stellte also weder ein 'Novum' in der Verordnung (EG) Nr. 715/2007 dar, noch war es bis zum 19. September 2015 Gegenstand des Fachaustauschs mit den Herstellern, den Technischen Diensten oder den Genehmigungsbehörden anderer Mitgliedstaaten.
english_gloss: However, it is difficult to understand that the head of the KBA should have been completely unfamiliar with this terminology until September 2015. The prohibition on the use of defeat devices already existed in the predecessor regulation and thus represented neither a novelty in Regulation (EC) No. 715/2007 nor was it subject to technical discussion with manufacturers, Technical Services or approval authorities of other member states until September 19, 2015.
context: The committee notes that the KBA head was completely unfamiliar with defeat device terminology until September 2015, despite the prohibition existing for years, indicating it was not a priority for leadership.

category: Redefinition of acceptable risk and standards
label: Motorschutz thermofenster acceptance narrowed over time
original_label: Motorschutz thermofenster acceptance narrowed over time
quote: Der Zeuge Odenwald hat erläutert, bei welchen Fahrzeugen der Gruppe II sich der Hinweis findet, dass Zweifel an der Zulässigkeit der Abschalteinrichtungen bestehen: Bei allen deutschen Herstellern wurde darauf hingewiesen; bei denen, wo wir nicht Typgenehmigungsbehörde sind, war dieser Hinweis nicht vorhanden.
english_gloss: Witness Odenwald explained which Group II vehicles contain the indication that there are doubts about the permissibility of the defeat devices: For all German manufacturers, this was indicated; for those where we are not the approval authority, this indication was not present.
context: Witness Odenwald describes how the KBA applied different standards to manufacturers it approved versus those approved elsewhere, suggesting inconsistent application of motor protection justifications.

label: Thermofenster described as technical compromise
original_label: Thermofenster described as technical compromise
quote: Es seien substanzielle Darlegungen und Belege verlangt worden, welche konkreten Gründe zur Verwendung von Abschalteinrichtungen zwängen. Der Zeuge Redmann hat bemerkt, dass auch Argumente einer aufwendigen technischen Umsetzung oder Kostengesichtspunkte in der Untersuchungskommission eine Rolle gespielt hätten, um eine Motorschutzeinrichtung zu rechtfertigen.
english_gloss: Substantial statements and evidence were demanded as to what specific reasons compelled the use of defeat devices. Witness Redmann noted that arguments of complex technical implementation or cost considerations also played a role in the investigation commission to justify a motor protection device.
context: Witnesses explain that cost and implementation complexity were accepted as justifications for motor protection devices, normalizing business convenience as technical necessity.

category: Institutionalization in routines, structures and technology
label: Thermofenster embedded in standard motor designs
original_label: Thermofenster embedded in standard motor designs
quote: Für das sogenannte Ausrampen der AGR-Menge in Abhängigkeit von Umgebungstemperatur/Temperatur im Ansaugsammler/Kühlwassertemperatur haben alle befragten Hersteller als Grund das Risiko einer Belagbildung im AGR-System angeführt. Dieses Risiko ist zweifelsfrei vorhanden und ist mit den herstellerunabhängigen Forschungsprojekten bestätigt.
english_gloss: For the so-called ramping down of the EGR quantity depending on ambient temperature/temperature in the intake manifold/coolant temperature, all interviewed manufacturers cited the risk of deposit formation in the EGR system as the reason. This risk is undoubtedly present and has been confirmed with independent research projects.
context: Technical description from the investigation commission report shows that thermal windowing was incorporated across multiple manufacturers as standard practice for deposit prevention.

label: Regulatory tolerance of thermofensters normalized
original_label: Regulatory tolerance of thermofensters normalized
quote: Die Untersuchungskommission hat die Zweifel formuliert, übrigens ich in der Pressekonferenz zur Untersuchungskommission auch sehr deutlich. Wir haben die Zweifel formuliert, dass das, was wir hier vorfinden in der Gruppe II, mit den europäischen Regeln im Einklang ist. Wir haben Zweifel formuliert, dass die Thermofenster vollumfänglich dem Motorschutz dienen.
english_gloss: The investigation commission formulated the doubts, and I also did so very clearly in the press conference on the investigation commission. We formulated doubts that what we find here in Group II is in line with European regulations. We formulated doubts that the thermal windows fully serve motor protection.
context: Transport minister Dobrindt publicly expresses doubts about thermofenster legitimacy but frames it as a matter of opinion rather than regulatory violation, normalizing the practice.

label: Manufacturers gradually educated regulators on thermofenster necessity
original_label: Manufacturers gradually educated regulators on thermofenster necessity
quote: Man habe gegenüber den Herstellern den Standpunkt vertreten, die Ausnahmeregelungen zum Motorschutz seien sehr eng auszulegen. Es seien substanzielle Darlegungen und Belege verlangt worden, welche konkreten Gründe zur Verwendung von Abschalteinrichtungen zwängen.
english_gloss: They took the position toward manufacturers that the exceptions for motor protection should be interpreted very narrowly. Substantial statements and evidence were demanded as to what specific reasons compelled the use of defeat devices.
context: Witness Odenwald describes how the investigation commission initially demanded strict justification from manufacturers but gradually accepted their technical explanations as legitimate.

category: Redefinition of acceptable risk and standards
label: Vehicle emissions in real conditions deemed incomparable to test conditions
original_label: Vehicle emissions in real conditions deemed incomparable to test conditions
quote: Die Emissionen von Stickstoffoxiden (NOx) können in realen Fahrsituationen über den Grenzwerten der Prüftests liegen. Hieraus ergab sich bis zum Bekanntwerden der VW-Manipulation kein Hinweis auf Manipulationen, da eine unterschiedliche Fahrsituation nicht vergleichbare Emissionswerte erzeugt.
english_gloss: Nitrogen oxide (NOx) emissions can exceed test limit values in real driving situations. Until the discovery of VW manipulation, this gave no indication of manipulations, as different driving situations produce non-comparable emission values.
context: Government response to parliamentary inquiry redefines real-world emissions violations as expected variation, not evidence of manipulation.

label: Software analysis capability absent at regulators
original_label: Software analysis capability absent at regulators
quote: Das KBA sei jedoch auch im November 2016 gerade erst dabei, das technische Know-how für Einblicke in die Motorsteuerungssoftware aufzubauen. Die Softwaredokumentation können wir aber – also, anlassbezogen sowieso – anfordern. Aber die ist also noch umfangreicher, die Softwaredokumentation. In der letzten Zeit hat sich eher bewährt, dann wirklich – gerade bei Zweifeln in Motorsteuerungen – mit entsprechenden Softwaresichtgeräten hineinzugehen.
english_gloss: The KBA was only just beginning to build technical expertise for insights into engine control software in November 2016. We can request the software documentation – that is, triggered by cause – but it is much more extensive, the software documentation. Recently, it has proven more useful to actually go into it with appropriate software viewing devices, especially when there are doubts about engine controls.
context: Witness Wummel from KBA acknowledges that as of November 2016 the agency was only beginning to develop technical capacity to analyze engine control software.

label: Manufacturer concerns prioritized over emissions standards
original_label: Manufacturer concerns prioritized over emissions standards
quote: Sie müssen sich vergegenwärtigen, dass alle Hersteller ungeachtet dessen, dass sie sich am Ende einer langen Diskussion bereit erklärt haben, eine freiwillige Serviceaktion zu machen, sehr, sehr großen Wert darauf gelegt haben, nichts Illegales zu machen. Und im Kern ist es dann einfach so, dass man gesagt hat: Gut, wir lassen dahinstehen, ob ein Ausrampen bei 10 Grad dem Geist und den Normen der Europäischen Kommission entspricht, wenn ihr das freiwillig abstellt.
english_gloss: You must bear in mind that all manufacturers, despite having agreed at the end of a long discussion to make a voluntary service action, placed great value on doing nothing illegal. And essentially, the point was that we said: Well, we leave unresolved whether a ramp-down at 10 degrees corresponds to the spirit and standards of the European Commission, if you voluntarily discontinue it.
context: Witness Zielke explains that the investigation commission abandoned enforcement of strict emissions rules in exchange for manufacturer cooperation on voluntary measures.

label: Industry practice as normalizing standard
original_label: Industry practice as normalizing standard
quote: Ob von Herstellern Schadensersatzklagen in Aussicht gestellt worden seien, falls deren Änderungswünsche nicht berücksichtigt würden, wisse er nicht. Die Kurztexte zu den einzelnen Fahrzeugmodellen seien seines Wissens schon aus Zeitgründen nicht mit den Herstellern rückgekoppelt worden.
english_gloss: Whether manufacturers indicated damage claims if their requests for changes were not considered, he does not know. The short texts for individual vehicle models were, to his knowledge, not fed back to the manufacturers due to time constraints.
context: Expert witness Wachtmeister indicates that technical text for vehicles was not returned to manufacturers for comment, suggesting normalization of information asymmetry.

category: Redefinition of acceptable risk and standards
label: Thermofenster boundaries treated as technically negotiable
original_label: Thermofenster boundaries treated as technically negotiable
quote: Man habe gegenüber den Herstellern den Standpunkt vertreten, die Ausnahmeregelungen zum Motorschutz seien sehr eng auszulegen. Es seien substanzielle Darlegungen und Belege verlangt worden, welche konkreten Gründe zur Verwendung von Abschalteinrichtungen zwängen. Der Zeuge Redmann hat bemerkt, dass auch Argumente einer aufwendigen technischen Umsetzung oder Kostengesichtspunkte in der Untersuchungskommission eine Rolle gespielt hätten.
english_gloss: They took the position toward manufacturers that the exceptions for motor protection should be interpreted very narrowly. Substantial statements and evidence were demanded as to what specific reasons compelled the use of defeat devices. Witness Redmann noted that arguments about difficult technical implementation or cost considerations also played a role in the investigation commission.
context: Investigation commission members indicate that cost and technical implementation difficulty were accepted as valid reasons for motor protection exceptions, redefining regulatory stringency.

category: Redefinition of acceptable risk and standards
label: Motor protection exception reinterpreted to permit any small damage
original_label: Motor protection exception reinterpreted to permit any small damage
quote: Statt den Schutz des Motors vor einem Schaden zu verlangen, beschränkt sich die Ausnahmevorschrift auf einen weitaus weniger gravierenden Schutz vor einer Beschädigung. Konsequenz der Regelungsunschärfe ist, dass unter Berufung auf den Motorschutz die Verwendung von Abschalteinrichtungen letztlich stets dann gerechtfertigt werden kann, wenn von Seiten des Fahrzeugherstellers nachvollziehbar dargestellt wird, dass ohne die Verwendung einer solchen Einrichtung dem Motor irgendeine Beschädigung droht, sei diese auch noch so klein.
english_gloss: Instead of demanding protection from damage, the exception requires only protection from impairment. As a consequence of this regulatory vagueness, manufacturers can justify shutdown devices by claiming that without them any damage—however small—might occur to the engine.
context: The commission's report describes how manufacturers exploited the vague motor-protection exception to justify shutdown devices, redefining acceptable risk downward.

category: Redefinition of acceptable risk and standards
label: Unclear standards give manufacturers wide interpretation latitude
original_label: Unclear standards give manufacturers wide interpretation latitude
quote: Im geltenden Recht begünstigen diese Auslegungsspielräume die Position der Hersteller... Ein zentrales Problem bei der Anwendung der Verordnung (EG) Nr. 715/2007 ist, was die normalen Betriebsbedingungen sind, unter denen die Wirksamkeit des Emissionsminderungssystems gewährleistet sein muss... Nach Aussage der Zeugen aus dem Kraftfahrt-Bundesamt und dem Bundesverkehrsministerium besteht in diesem Punkt eine erhebliche Rechtsunsicherheit, die sich nur durch klare Vorgaben zu Fahrstrecke, Fahrweise und Umgebungsbedingungen ausräumen ließe.
english_gloss: Current law favors manufacturers' position through wide interpretation. A central problem is the undefined meaning of 'normal operating conditions' under which emissions control must work. Officials acknowledge substantial legal uncertainty that could only be resolved through clear specifications.
context: The commission report identifies vague standards as systematically favoring manufacturers by creating wide latitude for reinterpretation.

label: KBA relies entirely on manufacturer documentation without independent verification
original_label: KBA relies entirely on manufacturer documentation without independent verification
quote: Das Kraftfahrt-Bundesamt prüft fortlaufend im Rahmen von Konformitätsprüfungen (CoP-P-Prüfungen), ob und wie die Fahrzeughersteller ihrer gesetzlichen Selbstverpflichtung nachkommen. Hierbei setzt das Kraftfahrt-Bundesamt grundsätzlich auf der Prüfdokumentation des Herstellers auf.
english_gloss: The KBA continually checks whether manufacturers meet their legal obligations. In doing this, the KBA fundamentally relies on the manufacturer's test documentation.
context: The report describes how the KBA's standard practice is to rely solely on manufacturer-provided documentation for conformity checks, creating structural dependence on the regulated entity.

label: No regulatory requirement for market surveillance systems in EU law
original_label: No regulatory requirement for market surveillance systems in EU law
quote: Eine über die Konformitätsprüfungen hinausgehende Überwachungspflicht durch Behörden gibt es mangels entsprechender europarechtlicher Festlegungen nicht. Anhang II der Verordnung (EG) Nr. 692/2008 enthält zwar allgemeine Bestimmungen darüber, dass 'Überwachungsprüfungen' der Genehmigungsbehörde und der Mitgliedstaaten bei der In-Service-Conformity-Prüfung der Genehmigungsbehörde berücksichtigt werden können. Es ist allerdings nicht geregelt, wie diese Überwachungsprüfungen der Mitgliedstaaten durchgeführt werden sollen und wer dazu berechtigt ist.
english_gloss: No requirement exists for authorities to conduct market surveillance beyond conformity checks due to lack of EU legal provisions. EU regulations allow—but do not require—surveillance testing.
context: The commission identifies a regulatory gap: EU law does not mandate independent market surveillance, only permitting it as optional.

label: Government sees motor-protection exception as legitimate broad interpretation
original_label: Government sees motor-protection exception as legitimate broad interpretation
quote: Dieser Auftrag war nach Überzeugung des Ausschusses umfassend und angemessen... Bezüglich der AusnahmeRegelungen zum Motorschutz hat die Untersuchungskommission von Anfang an eine strenge Auslegungslinie verfolgt und auch gegenüber den Herstellern vertreten. Die Gründe zur Verwendung von Motorschutzeinrichtungen wurden daher kritisch hinterfragt und von den Herstellern substanzielle technische Erklärungen eingefordert.
english_gloss: The inquiry commission pursued a strict interpretation line on motor-protection exceptions and questioned manufacturers' claims. Substantive technical explanations were demanded from manufacturers.
context: The commission claims its investigation followed a 'strict' interpretation line, yet the prior pages show the government had accepted manufacturers' broad reinterpretations for years.

label: 'Cycle beating' normalized as known phenomenon not requiring action
original_label: 'Cycle beating' normalized as known phenomenon not requiring action
quote: Die Genese der Gesetzgebung zu der Verordnung 715/2007 konnte sich der Untersuchungsausschuss aufgrund der Begrenzung des Untersuchungszeitraums nicht näher befassen. Die seit dem 18. September 2015 bekannt gewordenen Umstände, nach denen ein Großteil der Hersteller mit dem sogenannten Thermofenster 'arbeitet', das bewirkt, dass die Abgasreinigung bereits bei etwa 17/15 Grad Celsius heruntergefahren wird, spricht dafür, dass die Unklarheit in der Vorschrift zu Abschalteinrichtungen bewusst gewählt und von den Herstellern als vermeintliches 'Schlupfloch' ausgenutzt worden ist.
english_gloss: The fact that many manufacturers use 'thermal windows' to shut down emissions controls at around 17/15 degrees Celsius suggests that regulatory ambiguity was deliberately created and exploited by manufacturers as a supposed loophole.
context: The minority opinion (DIE LINKE) argues that the widespread use of thermal windows after 2015 shows the regulatory ambiguity was deliberately chosen and used as a known loophole.

category: Redefinition of acceptable risk and standards
label: Temperature-dependent emission reduction justified as motor protection
original_label: Temperature-dependent emission reduction justified as motor protection
quote: Insbesondere bei den von einigen Herstellern gewählten Thermofenstern bestanden von Anfang an Zweifel, ob sie in vollem Umfang durch den Motorschutz gerechtfertigt sind. Das Thermofenster bezeichnet Bereiche von Werten der Umgebungstemperatur, in denen die Abgasrückführrate reduziert wird, sogenanntes 'Ausrampen'. Da die Abgasprüfung im NEFZ Typ 1 in einem sehr engen Temperaturfenster zwischen 20 und 30 °C erfolgt, konnten die Prüfungen des Kraftfahrt-Bundesamtes hierzu vorher keine Anhaltspunkte liefern.
english_gloss: Thermal windows—ranges where exhaust recirculation is reduced—were justified as motor protection, but given that NEFZ testing occurs only in 20-30°C conditions, the KBA had no prior basis to detect them.
context: The inquiry describes thermal windows where emissions controls are shut down outside the 20-30°C test window, justified as motor protection despite doubts.

label: KBA lacked IT expertise to detect software-based manipulations
original_label: KBA lacked IT expertise to detect software-based manipulations
quote: Heute scheint man im für die Typgenehmigung verantwortlichen Kraftfahrt-Bundesamt (KBA) erkannt zu haben, dass beim Prüfverfahren moderner Fahrzeuge die Unterstützung von IT-Spezialisten hilfreich sein kann. Aber dieser Erkenntnisprozess, den der amtierende KBA-Präsident und Zeuge Ekhard Zinke bei seiner Aussage vor dem Untersuchungsausschuss als 'persönliche Lernkurve' bezeichnete, erfolgte erst lange nachdem der Abgasskandal durch die Aufdeckungen in den USA in den Fokus des öffentlichen Interesses gerückt war.
english_gloss: The KBA apparently only recently recognized that IT specialist support is helpful for testing modern vehicles. This learning process occurred long after the US revelations.
context: The Greens' statement describes the KBA's lack of IT expertise as a structural gap only recognized after the US EPA exposed VW.

label: KBA has no independent testing capacity or prüfstände
original_label: KBA has no independent testing capacity or prüfstände
quote: Das Kraftfahrt-Bundesamt typgenehmigt demnach Fahrzeuge, ohne diese zu prüfen oder Stichproben der Richtigkeit selbst durchzuführen. Auf die Frage des Grünen-Ausschussmitglieds Stephan Kühn, ob es vor Bekanntwerden des Abgasskandals im September 2015 eine Diskussion gegeben habe, ob es sinnvoll sei, eigene Prüfstände anzuschaffen, antwortete der Zeuge Klaus Pietsch: 'Also, wir haben nie Prüfstände besessen. Ich bin jetzt seit 1991 beim KBA, und in der Zeit haben wir definitiv keine Prüfstände gehabt.'
english_gloss: The KBA approves vehicles without testing them or conducting spot checks itself. A KBA witness testified: 'We never owned test stands. I have been at the KBA since 1991 and we definitely had no test stands during that time.'
context: The Greens cite testimony showing the KBA has no testing facilities and never discussed acquiring them before 2015.

label: Non-series test vehicles accepted as representative in type approval
original_label: Non-series test vehicles accepted as representative in type approval
quote: Wenn ich ein Vorserienfahrzeug habe, was dann hinsichtlich des Antriebsstrangs und der Abgasnachbehandlung dem entspricht, was dann in Serie gebaut werden soll, aber obendrauf ein anderer Hut ist, aber hinsichtlich der Massen alles passt beispielsweise, dann ist es legitim, damit eine Emissionsprüfung durchzuführen.
english_gloss: If a pre-production vehicle has the right drivetrain and emissions treatment for series production but other differences, it is legitimate to use it for emissions testing if masses align.
context: A KBA witness normalizes the use of pre-production vehicles for emissions testing, framing it as legitimate despite differences from series production.

label: Field monitoring responsibilities left entirely to manufacturers
original_label: Field monitoring responsibilities left entirely to manufacturers
quote: Nachdem die Fahrzeugtypen zugelassen wurden, vertrauen die deutschen Behörden ganz auf die Hersteller, dass auch die tatsächlich produzierten Fahrzeuge den Vorschriften entsprechen... Stattdessen testen die Autohersteller selbst, ob ihre Fahrzeuge ordnungsgemäß funktionieren. Tatsächlich prüft das Kraftfahrt-Bundesamt lediglich die Prüfungsunterlagen der Hersteller.
english_gloss: After vehicles are approved, German authorities rely entirely on manufacturers that actually-produced vehicles conform. Manufacturers test themselves; the KBA only reviews paperwork.
context: The Greens describe how German authorities rely entirely on manufacturer self-testing after type approval, with the KBA only reviewing paperwork.

label: Federal government prioritized auto industry interests over environmental enforcement
original_label: Federal government prioritized auto industry interests over environmental enforcement
quote: Das legt die Annahme nahe, dass sich Hersteller seinerzeit bewusst und erfolgreich für eine Verwässerung der Vorschriften zu Abschalteinrichtungen eingesetzt haben... Deutlich sind die Anmerkungen des Sachverständigen Prof. Dr. Koch. Bezogen auf die Frage, warum es eine Festlegung relativ strenger Grenzwerte gegeben habe, obwohl seit den 1990-iger Jahren, spätestens aber bei Erlass der Verordnung 715/2007 dem Verordnungsgeber bekannt gewesen sei, dass die Grenzwerte im Realbetrieb nicht eingehalten werden konnten: 'Wenn aber die Gesetzgebung so interpretiert worden wäre 2009: Ihr müsst unter allen realen Betriebszuständen das einhalten, also den Partikelgrenzwert 5 mg/km und die 180 mg/kg NOx, hätte man keinen einzigen Diesel mehr verkauft [...]'
english_gloss: Manufacturers apparently lobbied successfully to weaken shutdown device regulations. A witness explains that strict real-world enforcement in 2009 would have prevented any diesel sales.
context: The minority argues manufacturers successfully lobbied for vague shutdown device rules, and a witness explains that strict real-world enforcement would have made diesel sales impossible.

category: Redefinition of acceptable risk and standards
label: EU law permits wide interpretation of 'normal operating conditions'
original_label: EU law permits wide interpretation of 'normal operating conditions'
quote: Es muss den Normadressaten, also sowohl den Herstellern als auch den Typgenehmigungsbehörden, allein durch den Gesetzestext hinreichend klar sein, wann die Nutzung einer Abschalteinrichtung ausnahmsweise zulässig ist. Die Nutzung muss – wie vom Gesetzgeber nach Art. 5 Abs. 2 Satz 1 der Verordnung (EG) Nr. 715/2007 bezweckt – die Ausnahme werden, nicht die Regel.
english_gloss: The law must make clear to both manufacturers and authorities when shutdown devices are permitted as exceptions. These should be exceptions, not rules, as intended by the regulation.
context: The majority report calls for clarification that shutdown devices should be exceptions, not rules, acknowledging current law permits the opposite.

label: Euro 5 standard failed to reduce real-world emissions despite lower test limits
original_label: Euro 5 standard failed to reduce real-world emissions despite lower test limits
quote: Was ist dazu bekannt gewesen? Ich würde sagen: Ab 2006 ging das wirklich los, wo schon Hausberger - das ist im Prinzip auch aus der Gruppe, wo diese HBEFA-Daten [...] - - das ist dieses Handbuch für Kraftfahrzeugemissionen - - im Prinzip schon geschrieben, dass einfach die Minderung bei den aktuellen Prüfzyklen von Euro 5 nicht erreicht werden, wenn der Prüfzyklus eben nicht verändert wird, sondern wir eigentlich weiterhin gleich hohe Konzentrationen haben - - und dann auch in dem Handbuch, das 2009 das erste Mal rausgekommen ist, die Version 3.1, eigentlich auch zeigt, dass Euro 5 weiterhin gleich hohe Immissionen wie Euro 4 hat.
english_gloss: Starting in 2006, it was shown that the Euro 5 test cycle would not achieve emission reductions unless the test procedure changed; real-world concentrations remained as high as Euro 4. The 2009 emissions handbook confirmed Euro 5 gave emissions equal to Euro 4.
context: The Greens cite evidence from 2006 and 2009 handbooks showing that Euro 5 standards, despite lower test limits, failed to reduce real-world emissions.

label: No independent oversight of manufacturer self-testing
original_label: No independent oversight of manufacturer self-testing
quote: Stattdessen testen die Autohersteller selbst, ob ihre Fahrzeuge ordnungsgemäß funktionieren. Tatsächlich prüft das Kraftfahrt-Bundesamt lediglich die Prüfungsunterlagen der Hersteller.
english_gloss: Instead, the car manufacturers themselves test whether their vehicles function properly. In fact, the KBA merely examines the test documents of the manufacturers.
context: The report describes how KBA oversight was limited to checking manufacturer-submitted documents rather than conducting independent field testing, fragmenting knowledge of real-world emissions.

category: Redefinition of acceptable risk and standards
label: Abschalteinrichtungen redefined as permissible under exception clauses
original_label: Abschalteinrichtungen redefined as permissible under exception clauses
quote: Abschalteinrichtungen sind unzulässig, wenn sie auch in normalen, alltäglichen Situationen genutzt werden. Während den meisten Herstellern von der Untersuchungskommission deshalb die Absolution erteilt wurde, ist das EU-Recht unmissverständlich: Abschalteinrichtungen sind unzulässig, wenn sie auch in normalen, alltäglichen Situationen genutzt werden. Was zuvor in der Bundesregierung niemand gewusst haben will, wird nun vom Verkehrsminister als legal definiert, weil die Hersteller die Abschaltung der Abgasreinigung mit dem Motorschutz begründen.
context: The report shows how the investigation commission reinterpreted EU law to permit shutoff devices when justified by engine protection claims, while the same government had previously claimed not to know such justifications existed.

label: Transport minister refuses to apply available sanctions against manufacturers
original_label: Transport minister refuses to apply available sanctions against manufacturers
quote: Nein, Verkehrsminister Dobrindt hält bis heute seine schützende Hand über die Autoindustrie und verzichtet auf Bußgelder gegenüber den Herstellern. Ohnehin hat es die Bundesregierung jahrelang versäumt, überhaupt abschreckende Sanktionsmöglichkeiten zu schaffen.
context: The report states that despite EU Regulation 715/2007 requiring effective and deterrent sanctions, the transport minister refused to impose financial penalties on manufacturers found using prohibited defeat devices.

label: KBA lacked technical expertise to detect manipulations
original_label: KBA lacked technical expertise to detect manipulations
quote: Die tatsächliche Prüfung scheiterte bereits am mangelnden Verständnis der Beamten von Abschalteinrichtungen. Derselbe Zeuge konnte Fragen nach seiner grundsätzlichen Einschätzung zu Cycle Beating und zur Zykluserkennung sowie zur Frage, wann Manipulationen beginnen und rechtliche Absicherung enden, nicht beantworten: Nein. Kann ich Ihnen wirklich nichts sagen. Vor dem Skandal hat er sich nicht mit der rechtlichen Zulässigkeit von Abschalteinrichtungen befasst, obwohl das EU-Recht sie verbietet, denn vor September 2015 ist bei mir keine einzige Frage dazu angekommen.
context: KBA officials testified they had no understanding of defeat devices or cycle beating until after the scandal broke, despite being responsible for type approval; this fragmentation of knowledge enabled undetected violations.

label: Environmental ministry blocked by transport ministry on field monitoring proposal
original_label: Environmental ministry blocked by transport ministry on field monitoring proposal
quote: Im Verkehrsministerium und im Kraftfahrt-Bundesamt wollte man von Abschalteinrichtungen nichts wissen. Trotz der eklatanten Emissionswerte im Realbetrieb haben das Verkehrsministerium und das ihm unterstellte Kraftfahrt-Bundesamt in der Vergangenheit weggeschaut, um Problemen mit der Öffentlichkeit und den Autoherstellern aus dem Weg zu gehen.
context: The report documents that the transport ministry deliberately avoided investigating defeat devices despite documented real-world emission violations, prioritizing industrial relations over enforcement.

category: Institutionalization in routines, structures and technology
label: KBA capacity constraints embedded in staffing and procedures
original_label: KBA capacity constraints embedded in staffing and procedures
quote: Wir haben etwas Kapazitätsprobleme, sodass wir - - Also, wir haben natürlich versucht, alle Genehmigungen genau nachzuprüfen, genauso - - also Konformitätsprüfungen durchzuführen, so wie die Regelungen es vorschreiben. Allerdings haben wir ja etwas mehr als 100 000 Genehmigungen, die wir nicht alle prüfen können, kapazitätsmäßig. Auch interne Umstrukturierungen konnten am absoluten Personalmangel nichts ändern: Wir sind dadurch natürlich auch stärker, stärkere Mannschaft, aber immer noch zu wenig.
context: KBA witness testimony shows chronic understaffing that prevented checking conformity of over 100,000 approved vehicles, a structural constraint that institutionalized reliance on manufacturer self-reporting.

category: Redefinition of acceptable risk and standards
label: Cycle beating redefined from prohibited to acceptable practice
original_label: Cycle beating redefined from prohibited to acceptable practice
quote: Typgenehmigungserteilungen muss man sich so vorstellen, dass wir nach 250 Einzelrechtsakten Genehmigungen erteilen. In seinem Referat haben sich jedoch im Regelfall keine Juristen mit diesen Vorschriften befasst. Der Zeuge gab zu Protokoll: Zum Verständnis, welche Qualifikationen die Kolleginnen und Kollegen dort mitbringen: Im Referat arbeiten Verwaltungsfachangestellte und es arbeiten Ingenieure, jedoch keine Juristen. Rechtliche Bewertungen werden gleichwohl, bezogen auf den technischen Sachverhalt, im Referat durchgeführt, und in Zweifelsfällen arbeiten wir mit dem Grundsatzreferat bzw. dem Rechtsreferat innerhalb des KBA zusammen.
context: The report reveals that type approval decisions involving 250 separate legal standards were made by non-lawyers without specialized expertise, enabling reinterpretation of legal requirements for defeat devices.

label: Conformation factors escalated from 1.6 to 2.1 through successive negotiations
original_label: Conformation factors escalated from 1.6 to 2.1 through successive negotiations
quote: Während der Vorschlag der EU-Kommission für den Einstiegswert zunächst bei 1,6 lag, hatten sich das Umwelt- und Wirtschaftsministerium auf einen höheren Wert verständigt: Dieser sollte bei 1,95 liegen, wie die Zeugen Sigmar Gabriel und Jochen Flasbarth ausgeführt haben. Doch die Bundeskanzlerin hat auch diese Erhöhung noch übertroffen: Zusammen mit Frankreich hatte sie einen Konformitätsfaktor von 2,1 an EU-Kommissionspräsident Juncker herangetragen.
context: The report documents escalating permissiveness in conformity factors for real-world emissions testing, with each successive negotiation level increasing the allowable exceedance of legal limits.

label: Thermofenster justified as legitimate engine protection measure
original_label: Thermofenster justified as legitimate engine protection measure
quote: Viele Hersteller ließen die Abgasreinigung ihrer Fahrzeuge z. B. bei bestimmten Außentemperaturen – meist aus Kostengründen – einfach abstellen. Was zuvor in der Bundesregierung niemand gewusst haben will, wird nun vom Verkehrsminister als legal definiert, weil die Hersteller die Abschaltung der Abgasreinigung mit dem Motorschutz begründen.
context: Manufacturers and officials adopted a shared rationalization that temperature-dependent shutoff of emissions systems constituted legitimate engine protection rather than defeat devices, a collective reframing that enabled continued acceptance.

label: Field test stopped before completion when anomalies emerged
original_label: Field test stopped before completion when anomalies emerged
quote: Ein beteiligter Mitarbeiter der BASt wollte diesem Umstand nachgehen, wurde jedoch von einem Mitarbeiter des Kraftfahrt-Bundesamtes mit der Begründung ausgebremst, die Felduntersuchung habe nicht zum Ziel, Unregelmäßigkeiten beim CO2-Ausstoß festzustellen: Da die CO2-Ermittlung nicht direkter Bestandteil des Projektes ist und letztlich auch hier nur das stat. Verfahren ausreichend Klärung hinsichtlich Produktionsmangel bringen kann, ist meine Empfehlung, derzeit keine weitere Klärung von VW abzuverlangen. An diesem Fahrzeug war aber auch ein höherer Stickoxidausstoß aufgetreten, denn diese Softwaremaßnahme brachte zumindest in dem einen Testfall eine signifikante Erhöhung des NOx-Wertes (über Grenzwert) mit sich. Doch da es sich um einen Einzelfall handelte, wurde man auch hier nicht aktiv: Für mich ergibt sich hieraus nicht die Notwendigkeit weiterer Fragestellungen an die VW AG.
context: A KBA official blocked further investigation of anomalous emissions when they first appeared in 2011, using narrow project scope as justification, fragmenting knowledge that could have exposed the scandal earlier.

label: Bundeskanzlerin refuses to investigate Volkswagen directly
original_label: Bundeskanzlerin refuses to investigate Volkswagen directly
quote: Bundeskanzlerin Angela Merkel, MdB als Zeugin. Die Bundeskanzlerin hat den Abgasskandal nicht zur Chefsache erklärt. Angesichts der Gesundheitsgefahren für Millionen von Menschen in den Ballungsgebieten und der jährlich zehntausend vorzeitigen Todesfälle aufgrund von Stickoxiden ist dies ein Zeichen unverständlicher Ignoranz. Im Untersuchungsausschuss brachte die Bundeskanzlerin diese Einschätzung folgendermaßen auf den Punkt: Es war ja nicht unser Problem, sondern erst mal das Problem von VW.
context: The Chancellor's testimony shows leadership refusal to engage directly with the scandal despite documented public health harm, deferring responsibility entirely to the company.

category: Institutionalization in routines, structures and technology
label: Test procedure narrowed to exclude cycle beating detection
original_label: Test procedure narrowed to exclude cycle beating detection
quote: Übrig blieb ein Bonsai-Test: Was vom Umweltbundesamt als kontinuierliche und umfassende Feldüberwachung angelegt war, war letztlich ein einmaliges Projekt mit nur wenigen Fahrzeugen. Die Prüfung auf Konstruktionsteile für das Cycle Beating wurde dabei gestrichen. Zudem wurden die Fahrzeuge nicht abseits des NEFZ getestet, sondern nur nach diesem offiziellen Prüfverfahren – also genau der Test, bei dem die VW-Fahrzeuge manipulieren konnten.
context: The ambitious field monitoring proposal was deliberately scaled down and refocused to use only the standard test cycle, eliminating any capacity to detect the very manipulations it was designed to find.

label: Industry narrative that regulators would never test real driving conditions
original_label: Industry narrative that regulators would never test real driving conditions
quote: The signal was eindeutig und wurde von den Automobilherstellern auch so verstanden: Die Ergebnisse des NEFZ auf dem Prüfstand mussten stimmen, die Realität auf der Straße interessierte weder die Typgenehmigungsbehörde noch das Bundesverkehrsministerium. Das war eine Einladung an Hersteller, ihre Abgaskontrollsysteme in Dieselfahrzeugen unter bestimmten Bedingungen wie Prüfsituation auf dem Rollenprüfstand, Temperatur, Geschwindigkeit, Lenkwinkel, Meereshöhe usw. abzuschalten oder zu reduzieren.
context: The report identifies a shared understanding across industry that real-world emissions monitoring would not occur, creating a collectively understood signal that laboratory gaming was acceptable.

label: Transport Minister personally deleted group lawsuit provisions from report
original_label: Transport Minister personally deleted group lawsuit provisions from report
quote: Bereits früh wurde das Vorhaben von Verkehrsminister Dobrindt torpediert. In dem Entwurf des zuvor erwähnten Berichts für den Rechtsausschuss des Deutschen Bundestages war auch ein Kapitel zur Prüfung der Musterfeststellungsklage vorgesehen. Verkehrsminister Dobrindt hat dieses Kapitel höchstpersönlich gestrichen. In den Unterlagen des Verkehrsministeriums findet sich seine handschriftliche Notiz am Seitenrand: Lehnen wir ab!!! Komplett streichen!
context: The transport minister personally censored consumer protection provisions from a government report, signalling that industrial interests took priority over victims' legal remedies.

label: Investigation commission members received no written mandate
original_label: Investigation commission members received no written mandate
quote: Bereits die Zusammensetzung der Kommission zeigt, dass es Verkehrsminister Dobrindt dabei allein um Industriepolitik und nicht um eine Aufklärung im Sinne der Gesundheit der Bürgerinnen und Bürger ging. So bestand die von ihm einberufene Kommission lediglich aus Vertretern des Verkehrsministeriums und des Kraftfahrt-Bundesamtes sowie aus Prof. Dr. Georg Wachtmeister vom Lehrstuhl für Verbrennungskraftmaschinen der TU München. Auch der Untersuchungsauftrag der Kommission wurde in dieser Eile nach Aussage verschiedener Zeugen nie verschriftlicht oder konkretisiert. Das bestätigte zum Beispiel der Zeuge Dr. Frank Albrecht. Der Zeuge Stephan Redmann, selber Mitglied der Untersuchungskommission, führte ebenfalls aus: Also, an mich ist weder mündlich noch eben in schriftlicher Form der Auftrag der Untersuchungskommission herangetragen worden.
context: The investigation commission's charter was never formally documented, fragmenting understanding of its scope and enabling selective findings.

category: Redefinition of acceptable risk and standards
label: CO2 emissions redefined from test data to marketing claims
original_label: CO2 emissions redefined from test data to marketing claims
quote: Dass die Verbrauchs- bzw. CO2-Messergebnisse seit über einem Jahr unter Verschluss gehalten werden, ist unverantwortlich, da die Ergebnisse massive Auswirkungen auf die Steuereinnahmen des Bundes sowie auf die Rechte der Verbraucherinnen und Verbraucher und deren Kaufentscheidungen haben können. Die Kfz-Steuer berechnet sich teilweise nach den CO2-Emissionen des Fahrzeugs. Falls die tatsächlichen Emissionen des Fahrzeugs höher sind als die Werte, die bei der Typgenehmigung angegeben wurden, entgehen dem Staat Steuereinnahmen aufgrund der inkorrekten Bemessungsgrundlage.
context: The government withheld CO2 measurement results, redefining approved test values as the legitimate basis for taxation and consumer decisions despite evidence of systematic falsification.

label: Field monitoring rejected as beyond regulatory mandate
original_label: Field monitoring rejected as beyond regulatory mandate
quote: Eine unabhängige Feldüberwachung von Behörden war damals etwas, was über die Vorgaben des Regelwerks insofern hinausging, als es keine gelebte Praxis war. Die Praxis war eine Selbstüberprüfung durch die Hersteller, überprüft oder gemonitort durch ein Typgenehmigungsbehörde. Sachverständige wie Dr. h. c. Andreas Mayer sehen darin die Verletzung staatlicher Pflichten. Bei der In-Use Compliance handele es sich um eine Prüfpflicht des Staates, um die Konformität im Einsatz und in Kundenhand über die Laufzeit eines Fahrzeugtyps immer wieder nachzuweisen.
context: Government officials rationalized that independent monitoring was beyond their authority despite EU law requiring it, redefining self-testing as accepted practice.

label: Investigation commission accepted unverified manufacturer explanations
original_label: Investigation commission accepted unverified manufacturer explanations
quote: Die Untersuchungskommission testete die Stickoxidemissionen von über 50 Fahrzeugen. Im Abschlussbericht vom April 2016 bestätigte Verkehrsminister Dobrindt lapidar und pauschal, was von Kritikern schon lange vermutet worden war: Nicht nur Volkswagen hatte die Abgassysteme manipuliert, sondern die gesamte Branche. Doch dabei hatte die Untersuchungskommission noch nicht einmal alle Abschalteinrichtungen entdeckt, die eingesetzt werden, noch die richtigen Schlussfolgerungen gezogen. Im November 2016, ein halbes Jahr nach Veröffentlichung des Abschlussberichts der Untersuchungskommission, berichtete eine auflagenstarke Sonntagszeitung über neue Vorwürfe von Abschalteinrichtungen in Fahrzeugen von Audi. Im Untersuchungsbericht heißt es, dass die Aufwärmstrategie nach Herstellerangaben auf dem Prüfstand wie auf der Straße gleichermaßen angewendet werde.
context: The investigation commission's fragmented knowledge was exposed when it failed to detect Audi defeat devices that were later discovered, having trusted unverified manufacturer representations.

label: Environmental Ministry pressure required to convince transport ministry of field monitoring need
original_label: Environmental Ministry pressure required to convince transport ministry of field monitoring need
quote: Eine unabhängige Überprüfung der Kraftfahrzeuge durch eine Verkehrsbehörde war insofern in gewisser Weise Neuland. Und dieses Neuland zu beschreiten, bedurfte einer gewissen Aktivierungsenergie. So haben das Umweltministerium und das Umweltbundesamt mit einem entsprechenden Vorstoß die Verkehrsbehörden versucht von einer Notwendigkeit zu überzeugen.
context: The environmental ministry had to agitate to convince the transport ministry to adopt field monitoring, showing how the deviant practice (self-testing only) had become the default expectation requiring active pressure to overcome.

label: Manufacturers' concerns given higher priority than verification
original_label: Manufacturers' concerns given higher priority than verification
quote: Zweifel an der Glaubwürdigkeit der Untersuchungskommission bei der Bewertung der Abschalteinrichtungen bestehen auch, da offenbar die Interpretation der Messergebnisse und die Texte des Untersuchungsberichts teilweise mit den Autoherstellern abgesprochen wurden. So berichtete die Nachrichtenseite Spiegel online im November 2016 darüber, wie rücksichtsvoll die Untersuchungskommission mit den Einwänden der Hersteller umging. Ergebnistexte für den Untersuchungsbericht wurden offenbar mit Herstellern abgestimmt. Über andere Vorgänge heißt es, die Veröffentlichung der Ergebnisse sei mit den Herstellern vorab konkret besprochen worden. Dabei wurden laut Bericht teilweise sogar Formulierungen geändert, da der Hersteller an dieser Stelle so empfindlich sei.
context: Investigation commission findings were coordinated with manufacturers, with wording changed to accommodate industry sensitivities, showing leadership tolerance for corrupting independence.

label: Software updates systematically changed emission control behavior
original_label: Software updates systematically changed emission control behavior
quote: Bei den Messungen wurde festgestellt, dass zunächst die Kohlenmonoxidwerte der Fahrzeuge nicht stimmten. Nach einer Softwareaktualisierung bei den Fahrzeugen durch VW stellte sich dann heraus, dass einer der VW-Golf einen besseren CO2-Wert aufwies als die anderen Fahrzeuge.
context: Serial software updates in field test vehicles altered emissions performance in ways investigators found suspicious, suggesting incremental refinement of defeat logic during real-world testing.

category: Redefinition of acceptable risk and standards
label: WLTP escape clauses permit continued manipulation
original_label: WLTP escape clauses permit continued manipulation
quote: Solange die von den Herstellern selbst beauftragten Labortests die Einhaltung der Grenzwerte unter Laborbedingungen bestätigten, hielt das Kraftfahrt-Bundesamt alle Anforderungen für erfüllt. Die realen Emissionen außerhalb der Prüflabore interessierten die Behörde nicht. Wenn ab September 2017 nach dem neuen WLTP-Prüfzyklus und mit RDE-Straßentests die Abgaswerte gemessen werden, enden nach über zwei Jahrzehnten die Emissionsprüfungen nach dem NEFZ, der bereits bei seiner Einführung als unzureichend kritisiert wurde. Seine Ablösung kommt viel zu spät, wenn man sich vergegenwärtigt, wie viele nach dem NEFZ geprüfte Fahrzeuge auf den Straßen unterwegs sind und mit ihren überhöhten Emissionen die Atemluft für Millionen Menschen belasten.
context: The report shows that even new test procedures permitted escape clauses allowing reinterpretation of what counted as compliant.

label: Industry participation in writing new emissions regulations
original_label: Industry participation in writing new emissions regulations
quote: Der RDE-Prozess geht über mehrere Jahre hinweg. Da sind überwiegend Autohersteller mit am Tisch, also wir auch; aber es ist letztlich immer eine Minderzahl von unabhängigen Behörden und auch unabhängigen Organisationen, sondern das sind in der Regel vor allem Industrievertreter, die da letztlich ihre eigene Regulierung mitschreiben - ein ganz anderer Prozess.
context: An expert witness testifies that manufacturers dominated the regulatory negotiations for real-driving emissions standards, enabling them to shape rules in their favor.

label: Scheme evolution from 1999 through late 2001
original_label: Scheme evolution from 1999 through late 2001
quote: From at least 1999 through late 2001, defendants JEFFREY K. SKILLING and RICHARD A. CAUSEY and their coconspirators engaged in a wide-ranging scheme to deceive the investing public, the SEC, credit rating agencies and others (the 'Victims') about the true performance of Enron's businesses by: (a) manipulating Enron's finances so that Enron's publicly reported financial results would falsely appear to meet or exceed analysts' expectations; and (b) making public statements and representations about Enron's financial performance and results that were false and misleading in that they did not fairly and accurately in all material respects represent Enron's actual financial condition and performance, and omitted to disclose facts necessary to make those statements and representations truthful and accurate.
context: DOJ charging document describing the temporal scope and basic structure of the conspiracy as it unfolded over multiple years.

label: Escalation from quarterly to post-close earnings targets
original_label: Escalation from quarterly to post-close earnings targets
quote: From time to time, without regard to the actual performance of the company, defendants JEFFREY K. SKILLING and RICHARD A. CAUSEY and their coconspirators arbitrarily increased budget targets at or near the end of a quarter so that Enron could exceed analysts' expectations by falsely appearing to achieve and publicly reporting a higher than projected earnings-per-share result. At times, SKILLING and CAUSEY caused these revisions to earnings-per-share results even after the close of a quarter, when they knew that Enron had not in fact achieved the reported results and again without regard to the company's actual business performance for that quarter.
context: Charging document describing escalation in the timing and arbitrariness of target manipulation.

label: Raptor structures repeated across four iterations
original_label: Raptor structures repeated across four iterations
quote: Beginning in the spring of 2000, Enron and LJM engaged in a series of financial transactions with four SPEs called Raptor I, Raptor II, Raptor III and Raptor IV (collectively referred to as the 'Raptors'). Defendants JEFFREY K. SKILLING and RICHARD A. CAUSEY, Fastow, Enron Treasurer Ben F. Glisan, Jr., and their coconspirators used the Raptors to manipulate fraudulently Enron's reported financial results. They designed and approved Raptor I, among other things, to protect Enron from having to report publicly in its financial results decreases in value in large portions of its energy merchant asset portfolio and technology investments by hedging the value of those investments with an allegedly independent third party created by Enron and LJM, known as Talon. The basic structure used in Raptor I, including CAUSEY's and Fastow's oral side deal, was repeated in the three successor Fraudulent hedging devices known as Raptors II, III and IV.
context: Charging document showing how a fraudulent financial device was replicated and scaled from one iteration to four.

label: Reserve accounts grew from tens of millions to over one billion
original_label: Reserve accounts grew from tens of millions to over one billion
quote: From the third quarter of 2000 through the third quarter of 2001, defendants JEFFREY K. SKILLING and RICHARD A. CAUSEY and their coconspirators fraudulently used reserve accounts within Enron Wholesale to mask the extent and volatility of Enron Wholesale's windfall trading profits, particularly its profits from the California energy markets, to avoid reporting large losses in other areas of its business, and to preserve the earnings for use in later quarters in which Enron could improperly use them to meet analysts' expectations. By early 2001, undisclosed reserve accounts within Enron Wholesale, which prior to mid-2000 had held only tens of millions of dollars of Enron's energy trading earnings, contained over $1 billion in unreported earnings.
context: Charging document showing magnitude of growth in a concealment mechanism over approximately one year.

label: LJM transactions escalated in scope and technique
original_label: LJM transactions escalated in scope and technique
quote: From approximately July 1999 through October 2001, Enron entered into transactions with LJM that defrauded the Victims. The transactions with LJM enabled Enron, among other things, to: (a) manipulate its reported financial results by readily and unobtrusively moving poorly performing assets off balance sheet, when in fact such off-balance-sheet treatment was improper; (b) conceal Enron's poor operating performance by engaging in transactions designed to close gaps between Enron's actual business results and its stated financial reporting goals; (c) manufacture earnings through sham transactions when Enron was having trouble otherwise meeting its goals for a quarter or year; and (d) improperly inflate the value of Enron's investment portfolio by backdating documents when advantageous to Enron.
context: Charging document describing evolution of LJM transactions from basic structure to diverse manipulative techniques over two-year period.

category: Redefinition of acceptable risk and standards
label: Accounting rules reinterpreted to permit improper Raptor structure
original_label: Accounting rules reinterpreted to permit improper Raptor structure
quote: As defendants JEFFREY K. SKILLING and RICHARD A. CAUSEY well knew, however, the Raptor I structure was invalid under applicable accounting rules because Talon was not independent from Enron, and LJM's investment in Talon was not sufficiently at risk to qualify as outside equity. CAUSEY and Fastow had an oral side deal that LJM would receive its initial investment of $30 million in Talon plus a profit of $11 million from Enron, all prior to Talon engaging in any of the hedging transactions for which it was created. As a quid pro quo for this payment to LJM, Fastow agreed with CAUSEY that Enron employees could use Raptor I to manipulate Enron's balance sheet including by allowing Enron employees, without negotiation or due diligence on behalf of LJM, to select the values at which the Enron assets were hedged with Talon.
context: Charging document showing defendants knowingly structured a transaction to circumvent accounting standards while understanding it violated those rules.

category: Redefinition of acceptable risk and standards
label: Budget targets decoupled from operational capability
original_label: Budget targets decoupled from operational capability
quote: Defendants JEFFREY K. SKILLING and RICHARD A. CAUSEY and their coconspirators set the targets by determining the numbers necessary for each Enron business unit to produce in order to meet Enron's mandates for growth and analysts' expectations, rather than by determining how much earnings and cash flow that a particular business unit could reasonably be expected to generate. On a quarterly and year-end basis, SKILLING and CAUSEY and others assessed Enron's progress toward its budget targets. When the budget targets were not met through actual results from business operations, the desired targets were achieved through the use of various earnings and cash flow 'levers,' including but not limited to those described in this Superseding Indictment.
context: Charging document describing how standards for financial targets were redefined to prioritize analyst expectations over actual operational results.

category: Redefinition of acceptable risk and standards
label: Financial transactions assessed by accounting goal rather than economic substance
original_label: Financial transactions assessed by accounting goal rather than economic substance
quote: As described more fully in this Superseding Indictment, many of the levers used by Enron to fill the shortfall between its budget targets and its actual performance were complex transactions designed primarily to achieve specific accounting results. The structure of many such transactions was inconsistent with the transactions' underlying economic substance. Other transactions actually were to Enron's financial detriment but were completed because they achieved desired accounting goals that could improve Enron's apparent performance. Often these transactions were completed in haste near, and at times after, the close of a financial reporting period.
context: Charging document showing that accounting results were treated as the legitimate objective, even when contrary to economic reality or company interest.

category: Redefinition of acceptable risk and standards
label: Losses characterized as nonrecurring to mask underlying pattern
original_label: Losses characterized as nonrecurring to mask underlying pattern
quote: Enron misleadingly described the hundreds of millions of dollars in losses stemming from the 'unwind,' or abandonment, of the 'Raptors' as 'nonrecurring' losses, that is, a one-time or unusual earnings event. However, as defendant RICHARD A. CAUSEY well knew, over the course of prior quarters, Enron had characterized the positive earnings that it previously recognized, and then hedged, from these same assets as ordinary operating earnings that could be expected to recur.
context: Charging document showing how standards for classification of earnings were applied inconsistently to obscure the pattern.

category: Institutionalization in routines, structures and technology
label: Board approval obtained for LJM structure to enable SPE transactions
original_label: Board approval obtained for LJM structure to enable SPE transactions
quote: In June 1999, in order to have a purportedly independent third party available to provide this outside equity funding so that Enron could more easily create and use SPEs to achieve its desired financial reporting results, defendants JEFFREY K. SKILLING and RICHARD A. CAUSEY and others sought and obtained the approval of Enron's Board of Directors (the 'Board') for CFO Fastow to create and serve as the managing partner of an investment partnership named LJM1 that would invest in SPEs for Enron. The Board later approved Fastow's participation in another even larger entity used to fund SPEs by Enron, LJM2 (the LJM entities are collectively referred to as 'LJM' unless otherwise noted).
context: Charging document showing institutionalization through formal board approval that created standing structures for repeated manipulative transactions.

category: Institutionalization in routines, structures and technology
label: Quarterly earnings and cash flow targets established as management routine
original_label: Quarterly earnings and cash flow targets established as management routine
quote: Defendants JEFFREY K. SKILLING and RICHARD A. CAUSEY were among the principal architects and operators of the scheme to manipulate Enron's reported financial results and to present Enron in a misleading manner. Together with their coconspirators, they set annual and quarterly earnings and cash flow targets ('budget targets') for the company as a whole and for each of Enron's business units. In furtherance of the scheme to defraud, SKILLING and CAUSEY, together with their coconspirators and others, predetermined Enron's budget targets and 'backed into' those targets through, among other things, the use of deceptive accounting devices.
context: Charging document showing how fraudulent target-setting became a standardized management practice rather than occasional manipulation.

category: Institutionalization in routines, structures and technology
label: SPE framework embedded as standard tool for financial reporting
original_label: SPE framework embedded as standard tool for financial reporting
quote: One of the levers by which defendants JEFFREY K. SKILLING and RICHARD A. CAUSEY and their coconspirators ensured that Enron met financial reporting targets was the creation and use of Special Purpose Entities ('SPEs'). SPEs were used to achieve 'off-balance-sheet' accounting treatment of assets and business activities so that Enron could present itself more attractively as measured by criteria favored by securities analysts, credit rating agencies, and others. context: GAO documents the escalation of Purdue's advertising expenditure for OxyContin over the first five years of marketing.

label: Bonuses tied to OxyContin sales increase forty-fold in five years
original_label: Bonuses tied to OxyContin sales increase forty-fold in five years
quote: The amount of total bonuses that Purdue estimated were tied to OxyContin sales increased significantly from about $1 million in 1996, when OxyContin was first marketed, to about $40 million in 2001.
context: GAO documents the escalating financial incentives for sales representatives tied to OxyContin sales growth from 1996 to 2001.

label: Indication expanded from cancer pain to wide range of noncancer conditions
original_label: Indication expanded from cancer pain to wide range of noncancer conditions
quote: From the outset of the OxyContin marketing campaign, Purdue promoted the drug to physicians for noncancer pain conditions that can be caused by arthritis, injuries, and chronic diseases, in addition to cancer pain.
context: GAO describes how Purdue's marketing strategy progressively broadened the target patient population from cancer pain to diverse noncancer pain conditions.

label: Promotional messaging shifted to position as first-line opioid therapy
original_label: Promotional messaging shifted to position as first-line opioid therapy
quote: From OxyContin's launch until its July 2001 label change, Purdue used two key promotional messages for primary care physicians and other high prescribers. The first was that physicians should prescribe OxyContin for their pain patients both as the drug to start with and to stay with. The second contrasted dosing with other opioid pain relievers with OxyContin dosing as the hard way versus the easy way to dose because OxyContin's twice-a-day dosing was more convenient for patients.
context: GAO documents the evolution of Purdue's core marketing messages to position OxyContin as initial therapy rather than second-line treatment.

category: Redefinition of acceptable risk and standards
label: Controlled-release formulation misclassified as lower abuse potential
original_label: Controlled-release formulation misclassified as lower abuse potential
quote: OxyContin's controlled-release formulation, which delayed the drug's absorption, also led FDA to include language in the original label stating that OxyContin had a lower potential for abuse than other oxycodone products. FDA officials thought that the controlled-release feature would make the drug less attractive to abusers. However, FDA did not recognize that the drug could be dissolved in water and injected, which disrupted the controlled-release characteristics and created an immediate rush or high, thereby increasing the potential for abuse.
context: GAO explains how FDA's original label classification of OxyContin's abuse risk was based on a misunderstanding of how abusers could circumvent the formulation.

category: Redefinition of acceptable risk and standards
label: Safety warning inadvertently signals method for drug abuse
original_label: Safety warning inadvertently signals method for drug abuse
quote: In addition, the safety warning on the label that advised patients not to crush the tablets because a rapid release of a potentially toxic amount of the drug could result—a customary precaution for controlled-release medications—may have inadvertently alerted abusers to a possible method for misusing the drug.
context: GAO identifies how a standard safety warning was reinterpreted as providing instruction to potential abusers on how to circumvent the drug's formulation.

category: Redefinition of acceptable risk and standards
label: Addiction incidence statement lacks scientific foundation
original_label: Addiction incidence statement lacks scientific foundation
quote: The video included a statement that opioid analgesics have been shown to cause addiction in less than 1 percent of patients. According to FDA, this statement has not been substantiated. The physician in the videos also stated that opioid analgesics have been shown to cause addiction in less than 1 percent of patients—a fact that FDA has stated has not been substantiated.
context: GAO documents how Purdue's promotional materials made unsubstantiated claims about addiction rates in order to minimize perceived risks.

category: Institutionalization in routines, structures and technology
label: Speaker training conferences conducted annually at resort locations
original_label: Speaker training conferences conducted annually at resort locations
quote: During the first 5 years that OxyContin was marketed, Purdue conducted over 40 national pain management and speaker training conferences, usually in resort locations such as Boca Raton, Florida, and Scottsdale, Arizona, to recruit and train health care practitioners for its national speaker bureau. The trained speakers were then made available to speak about the appropriate use of opioids, including oxycodone, the active ingredient in OxyContin, to their colleagues in various settings, such as local medical conferences and grand round presentations in hospitals involving physicians, residents, and interns. Over the 5 years, these conferences were attended by more than 5,000 physicians, pharmacists, and nurses, whose travel, lodging, and meal costs were paid by the company.
context: GAO documents how Purdue institutionalized physician recruitment and training through a formalized conference system that operated continuously from 1996 through 2000.

category: Institutionalization in routines, structures and technology
label: Systematic prescriber targeting using IMS Health data
original_label: Systematic prescriber targeting using IMS Health data
quote: Since the launch of OxyContin, Purdue has provided its sales force with considerable information to help target physicians and prioritize sales contacts within a sales territory. Sales representatives routinely receive daily, weekly, monthly, and quarterly physician prescribing reports based on IMS Health data that specify the physicians who have written prescriptions for OxyContin and other opioid analgesics, and the number of prescriptions written.
context: GAO describes how Purdue embedded systematic physician targeting into its standard sales operations through routine data reports.

category: Institutionalization in routines, structures and technology
label: Over 20,000 educational programs sponsored or funded
original_label: Over 20,000 educational programs sponsored or funded
quote: From 1996, when OxyContin was introduced to the market, to July 2002, Purdue has funded over 20,000 pain-related educational programs through direct sponsorship or financial grants. These grants included support for programs to provide physicians with opportunities to earn required continuing medical education credits, such as grand round presentations at hospitals and medical education seminars at state and local medical conferences.
context: GAO documents how Purdue embedded its marketing strategy into a large-scale infrastructure of funded educational programs operating across the country for six years.

category: Institutionalization in routines, structures and technology
label: Branded promotional items distributed systematically
original_label: Branded promotional items distributed systematically
quote: As part of its marketing campaign, Purdue distributed several types of branded promotional items to health care practitioners. Among these items were OxyContin fishing hats, stuffed plush toys, coffee mugs with heat-activated messages, music compact discs, luggage tags, and pens containing a pullout conversion chart showing physicians how to calculate the dosage to convert a patient to OxyContin from other opioid pain relievers.
context: GAO documents how Purdue institutionalized branded promotional merchandise as a standard marketing tool for OxyContin.

category: Institutionalization in routines, structures and technology
label: Starter coupon program integrated into marketing over four years
original_label: Starter coupon program integrated into marketing over four years
quote: For the first time in marketing any of its products, Purdue used a patient starter coupon program for OxyContin to provide patients with a free limited-time prescription. A sales representative distributes coupons to a physician, who decides whether to offer one to a patient, and then the patient redeems it for a free prescription through a participating pharmacy. The program began in 1998 and ran intermittently for 4 years. In 1998 and 1999, each sales representative had 25 coupons that were redeemable for a free 30-day supply. In 2000 each representative had 90 coupons for a 7-day supply, and in 2001 each had 10 coupons for a 7-day supply. Approximately 34,000 coupons had been redeemed nationally when the program was terminated following the July 2001 OxyContin label change.
context: GAO describes how Purdue institutionalized patient trial programs into its sales operations from 1998 through 2001.

category: Institutionalization in routines, structures and technology
label: Sales compensation formula tied to OxyContin quotas
original_label: Sales compensation formula tied to OxyContin quotas
quote: Although the sales representatives were primarily focused on OxyContin promotion, the amount of the bonus depended on whether a representative met the sales quotas in his or her sales territory for all company products. As OxyContin's sales increased, Purdue's growth-based portion of the bonus formula increased the OxyContin sales quotas necessary to earn the same base sales bonus amounts.
context: GAO explains how Purdue embedded OxyContin sales targets into the formal compensation structure for all sales representatives.

category: Institutionalization in routines, structures and technology
label: Hospital Specialty Division created specifically for OxyContin promotion
original_label: Hospital Specialty Division created specifically for OxyContin promotion
quote: By 2000, Purdue had more than doubled its own internal sales force to 671. The expanded sales force included sales representatives from the Hospital Specialty Division, which was created in 2000 to increase promotional visits on physicians located in hospitals.
context: GAO documents how Purdue created a new organizational division dedicated to expanding OxyContin promotion in hospitals.

label: Widespread pain management need framed as unmet medical crisis
original_label: Widespread pain management need framed as unmet medical crisis
quote: Since 1986, the World Health Organization (WHO) and others have reported that the inadequate treatment of cancer and noncancer pain is a serious public health concern. To address this concern, efforts have been made to better educate health care professionals on the need to improve the treatment of both cancer and noncancer pain, including the appropriate role of prescription drugs. Amid the heightened awareness that many people were suffering from undertreated pain, in 1995 the Food and Drug Administration (FDA) approved the new drug OxyContin.
context: GAO documents the medical and organizational consensus that positioned pain relief as a critical public health priority, providing a cultural frame that Purdue leveraged.

label: Pseudoaddiction concept minimizes addiction concerns
original_label: Pseudoaddiction concept minimizes addiction concerns
quote: Concerns about abuse, addiction, and diversion should not prevent the proper management of pain. The development of addiction to opioid analgesics in properly managed patients with pain has been reported to be rare.
context: Language from FDA-approved OxyContin labeling that reframes addiction concerns as a distraction from the imperative to treat pain.

label: Industry-wide guidelines issued after OxyContin approved and already marketed
original_label: Industry-wide guidelines issued after OxyContin approved and already marketed
quote: At the time that OxyContin was first marketed, there were no industry or federal guidelines for the promotion of prescription drugs. Voluntary guidelines regarding how drug companies should market and promote their drugs to health care professionals were issued in July 2002 by the Pharmaceutical Research and Manufacturers of America (PhRMA).
context: GAO notes that when OxyContin was launched in 1996, the absence of formal industry guidelines meant there were no shared standards to constrain marketing practices.

label: Sales representatives trained on promotional messaging and physician targeting
original_label: Sales representatives trained on promotional messaging and physician targeting
quote: Each Purdue sales representative has a specific sales territory and is responsible for developing a list of about 105 to 140 physicians to call on who already prescribe opioids or who are candidates for prescribing opioids. Each Purdue sales representative is expected to make about 35 physician calls per week and typically calls on each physician every 3 to 4 weeks. Purdue stated it offered a better than industry average salary and sales bonuses to attract top sales representatives and provide incentives to boost OxyContin sales as it had done for MS Contin.
context: GAO describes how Purdue systematically trained sales representatives in targeting and messaging while using above-average compensation to recruit and retain them.

label: Physicians recruited and trained through speaker bureau
original_label: Physicians recruited and trained through speaker bureau
quote: During the first 5 years that OxyContin was marketed, Purdue conducted over 40 national pain management and speaker training conferences, usually in resort locations such as Boca Raton, Florida, and Scottsdale, Arizona, to recruit and train health care practitioners for its national speaker bureau. Purdue's speaker bureau list from 1996 through mid-2002 included nearly 2,500 physicians, of whom over 1,000 were active participants.
